To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the cost of EM equipment is a significant cost component of the SHPP and the cost of EM for a given power is a function of the power, the head and the type of turbine (Pelton, Francis, Kaplan, Francis reversible).
the cost of electro mechanical equipments in a small hydroelectric power plant depends on the power and head of the plant.
the cost of electro mechanical (EM) equipment for the small hydropower plants is strongly dependent on the power and head.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new methodology to estimate the cost for electro mechanical equipment for small hydro power plants.
the development of new correlations to estimate the cost for EM equipment in small hydro power plants, which could help the decision making process in the development of these plants.
the cost of electro mechanical equipments for a small hydro power station.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

there are many ways to estimate the cost for the EM equipment of small hydro power plants, however, the cost of electro mechanical components of a small hydropower plant is not a simple task, and there is not a unique method to determine it.
the cost of electro mechanical equipments in a small hydro project can be estimated with a good accuracy by the use of the correlations presented here.
the cost of EM equipment for a small hydro power station can be estimated with a high degree of confidence by using the proposed correlations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the cost of EM equipment for small hydro power plants could be estimated with reasonable accuracy by using empirical correlations developed in the present paper.
the cost of EM equipment is not very sensitive to the head but it increases for high power.
the cost of EM equipment for a power level 2 MW and head 100 m is about 1.6 million USD.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there are many ways to build a hydro turbine and the cost of the machine can vary significantly.
the cost of EM equipment for small hydro power plants is very similar to the cost of EM for conventional hydropower plants.
the cost of electro-mechanical equipment for small hydro power plants can be estimated with a good degree of accuracy using the correlations developed in this work.
